definitions.gloss: heat level; heat control; temperature (of cooking fire/stove)
definitions.explanation: The degree of heat used in cooking. Refers to the skill of adjusting and maintaining the right temperature for various cooking techniques.

examples.japanese: {火加減|ひかげん}を{調整|ちょうせい}しながら{煮込|にこ}む。
examples.english: Simmer while adjusting the heat level.

examples.japanese: {中火|ちゅうび}の{火加減|ひかげん}で{焼|や}いてください。
{火加減|ひかげん}が{難|むずか}しくて、よく{焦|こ}がしてしまう。
examples.english: Heat control is difficult, so I often burn things.

notes:
HEAT LEVELS IN JAPANESE:
・{強火|つよび} (high heat)
・{中火|ちゅうび} (medium heat)
・{弱火|よわび} (low heat)
・とろ{火|び} (very low heat/simmer)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{火加減|ひかげん}を{調整|ちょうせい}する (to adjust the heat)
・{火加減|ひかげん}を{見|み}る (to check the heat level)
・{火加減|ひかげん}が{難|むずか}しい (heat control is difficult)

COOKING CONTEXT:
Proper {火加減|ひかげん} is considered essential for Japanese cooking, where subtle temperature control affects texture and flavor. Recipes often specify exact heat levels.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{火|ひ} (fire) + {加減|かげん} (adjustment/degree) = degree of fire → heat level

RELATED WORD:
・{塩加減|しおかげん} (salt level/seasoning with salt)
